issues.description: The exercise requires a globally visible variable named `shared_data` (problem_statement.md line 22). The template (template_repository/helloWorld.asm, section .data at lines 2-3) does not declare `shared_data` at all, and the provided solution (solution_repository/helloWorld.asm line 4) defines `shared_data dd 100` in the .data section but does not export it with a `global shared_data` directive. This mismatch means (a) students starting from the template will not have the required symbol to make tests that rely on `shared_data` pass, and (b) the solution as provided also fails to satisfy the requirement because the symbol is not exported, which will cause linking/test failures or confusion about how `shared_data` should be exposed.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the declaration and export of `shared_data` consistent across the template and solution: 1) In both template_repository/helloWorld.asm and solution_repository/helloWorld.asm add a data declaration such as `shared_data dd 100` in the .data section (or preserve the desired initial value). 2) Add a `global shared_data` directive (near the other `global` directives, e.g. above `main`) so the symbol is exported and visible to tests. Ensure the problem statement still documents that `shared_data` must be globally visible.
